newsitem.title: USA: Service Experts buying HVAC companies.
newsitem.headline: Service Experts buying HVAC companies.

text.p: Service Experts Inc said Friday it has acquired or signed agreements in principle to acquire 22 HVAC companies since May 1.
The company said the total consideration paid for the 10 completed acquisitions was about $13 million in cash, common stock and warrants to purchase common stock.
HVAC companies provide heating, ventilation and air conditioning services. Service Experts said the companies it bought, and will buy, have annualized revenues of about $44 million.

The company said four of the 10 companies have become new "hub" service centers. They are C. Iapaluccio Co Inc of Danbury, Conn.; Superior Air Conditioning Co Inc of Duncanville, Texas; Plano Air Mart Services of Dallas; and Peachtree-Cherokee/Edwards Heating & Air Conditioning of Atlanta.
The company said it expects to close the remaining 12 pending acquisitions during the third quarter.
Upon closing these acquisitions, Service Experts will operate 52 service centers in 24 states with annualized revenues of more than $214 million.
